plan_schema.matching: Exact equality; all non-null filters are ANDed. A filter plan may match zero, one, or multiple facts.

entity_constraints.syscall_result: decision=filter; caller_task_id, child_pid, and relation_type are null; process_id may be combined with syscall-result filters or used alone.
entity_constraints.process_relation: decision=filter; syscall, outcome, observed_errno, and lexical_path_exact are null.
entity_constraints.abstain: decision=abstain; entity=null; every filter field is null.
